summary: Small targeted fix: stops reporting primary keys as 'unique' in PostgreSQL constraint introspection so the introspector no longer conflates a PK with a separate UNIQUE constraint on the same column, letting the erroneous unique_together be dropped. Correct approach since PKs remain identifiable via the separate 'primary_key' flag.

issues.description: Any consumer that treated PK columns as 'unique' via this flag now must check 'primary_key' too; Django's own migration/schema code already distinguishes the two, so regression risk is low but non-zero.
Second hunk changes the final 'return constraints' line to an identical line (whitespace-only/no-op), adding pointless diff noise unrelated to the fix.
